title: 半跪往前一点
description: 成人半跪在厚垫上，骨盆轻前移，保持直立。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult kneels on one padded knee with the other foot planted forward, torso upright and hands resting lightly on the front thigh. Capture a very small forward shift of the pelvis, avoiding a deep lunge or arched back. The kneeling shin remains supported by the mat. A plain gym corner, soft window light, and a folded towel beside the mat frame this comfortable mobility moment. Use a painterly oil-pastel illustration with broken strokes, strong volume, a dusty pink and petrol-blue palette, and inviting natural light. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
